definitions.explanation: A single plate of food, used in counting servings and in prices.

examples.japanese: {一皿|ひとさら}{五百円|ごひゃくえん}です。
⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一皿|ひとさら}⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate a plate of curry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}→回転寿司：11900_kaitenzushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{一皿|ひとさら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二貫|にかん}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧のって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: At conveyor-belt sushi restaurants, each plate usually has two pieces.

notes:
COUNTING PATTERNS:
⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧ counts plates of food. One and two use native numbers: {一皿|ひとさら}, {二皿|ふたさら}; from three on, Sino-Japanese numbers: {三皿|さんさら}, {四皿|よんさら}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧: plate, dish
- ⟦{一人前|いちにんまえ}→一人前：06782_ichininmae⟧: one serving
